title: tx_queue_stats_get documentation falsely claims thread-safety
description:
File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 207

Line 207 documents 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock' but the implementation does NOT acquire the queue lock - it performs an unlocked struct copy with an explicit comment saying the read is NOT atomic. Callers relying on the documented guarantee could get torn reads of the 24-byte stats struct during concurrent updates to packet counters.
